name: noda-js-win-arm64
description: Optional native addon for noda-js/system on Windows on ARM64: reads Windows' time zone data as .NET's TimeZoneInfo does, without Node's experimental FFI. Installed automatically with noda-js; not used directly.
author: Jeremy Morren

scripts.prepack: node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE.txt', 'NOTICE.txt']) require('fs').copyFileSync('../../../' + f, f)"
